svg.title: A day in the town: one person's agent as patient, member, neighbour — and a window into her vault

g.text: ALICE'S ESTATE · HER HOME, HER AGENT, HER VAULT
read only · the coach · this season

g.text: a grant: coach may read my fitness goals
coach asks again → refused at the gate
here is its card · checked on the chain
holds: her keys, every permission, every receipt
One person. One agent. Many contexts.
Every building is an estate with its own agent. The roads are conversations. The keys never move.
One shelf, one reader, one season. Signed at her door.
